lots.what_it_is: Group of seven decorative masks: four carved and painted wooden Indonesian (Javanese or Balinese style) masks, being a white and black dog or cat dance mask with hair brows, a grey monkey mask with fur brows, a female topeng with black hair and gold forehead mark, and a cream female mask with painted headdress; plus a carved white panda mask with glass eyes, a painted Chinese opera style face mask on a black velvet strap, and a chrome finish Terminator T-800 skull mask with red eyes and red lacing (modern costume or display piece). No marks visible. Souvenir to mid-century decorative grade, not old ritual pieces.
lots.score_reason: Decorative and souvenir masks with no marks or signs of age. Tasmanian results for similar groups of wooden or Balinese masks run $2 to $40 hammer, so the realistic value of the group is about $30 to $60: 3.

lots.key_photo_findings: One photo, all seven masks face up. No maker's marks or labels visible. Indonesian masks have hand-painted detail and hair or fur brows typical of tourist and dance-souvenir pieces. The Terminator skull is a moulded chrome finish shell with red eyes and red cord lacing and a black strap, a costume or display mask, not a licensed half-scale collector skull. The opera mask is a painted moulded mask on a velvet strap.
